name: After § 27
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Ukraine
part_text: 27a. Welcomes the robust opposition, particularly from civil society, to the attempts to limit the independence of anti-corruption institutions, which compelled the authorities to backtrack; considers this step by the authorities an unfortunate attempt to scale back the achievements in the fight against corruption, which is a major requirement for EU integration; underscores that fighting corruption requires a long-term commitment and comprehensive efforts to establish good governance with well-functioning checks and balances;
